title: Open a sub-account for a member
description: Opens a new share sub-account of the given type for a member with an opening deposit, and returns the confirmation number and the new account suffix.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member number to open the sub-account for.

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.description: The kind of sub-account to open.

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.description: The member's nickname for the account.

outputs.name: confirmation_number
outputs.description: The application's confirmation number for the opened account.

outputs.name: new_suffix
outputs.description: The suffix assigned to the new sub-account.

provenance.goal: Sign on to the teller workstation, look up member {{inputs.member_id}}, and open a new sub-account for them: account type {{inputs.account_type}}, nickname {{inputs.nickname}}, opening deposit {{inputs.opening_deposit}}. Carry it through to the confirmation screen, then read the confirmation number and the new account suffix.
